export interface TeamEvent {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  calendar: CalendarId;
  start: ZonedDateTime;
  end: ZonedDateTime;
  location: string;
  guests: string[];
  isReadOnly?: boolean;
}

function at(month: number, day: number, hour: number, minute = 0) {
  return toZoned(
    new CalendarDateTime(2026, month, day, hour, minute),
    timeZone,
  );
}

function event(
  id: string,
  title: string,
  calendar: CalendarId,
  [month, day]: [number, number],
  [startHour, startMinute]: [number, number],
  [endHour, endMinute]: [number, number],
  location: string,
  guests: string[],
  isReadOnly?: boolean,
): TeamEvent {
  return {
    id,
    title,
    calendar,
    start: at(month, day, startHour, startMinute),
    end: at(month, day, endHour, endMinute),
    location,
    guests,
    isReadOnly,
  };
}
